target: CHARMM36 additive nucleic acid with explicitly fitted compatible lesion terms

relevant_existing_models.role: 5-methyldihydrouracil reference for the nonaromatic, C5-C6-saturated thymine ring environment; charges and bonded terms are transfer candidates only
dihydrouracil reference separating saturation effects from the C5 methyl substituent; transfer candidate only
cyclobutane ring-strain bond, angle, torsion, and CG3C41 nonbonded reference; the unsubstituted hydrocarbon is not a lesion model

cgenff_reference_library.authority: initial atom-type, Lennard-Jones, and transferable-term candidates requiring lesion-specific tests
not_authority: automatic transfer of BMDU or CBU charges and terms to the fused TT-CPD ring

mixing_rule: Do not replace the CHARMM36 nucleic-acid model with CGenFF. Use compatible CGenFF terms only as documented candidates at the chemically modified site, then fit and validate the lesion-specific package.
